source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of the chapter 9 exercise (PDF 139-140): the questions, the answers from the text beside the printed key, and where each question is explained.

blocks.text:
1. In mein se kaun si cheez online accounts ko mehfooz rakhti hai?
(a) Kamzor passwords
(b) Mazboot passwords
(c) Passwords share karna
(d) Saada passwords

2. Na-maloom software download karne ka sab se bara khatra kya hai?
(a) Tez browsing
(b) Inaam milna
(c) Malware infection
(d) Izafi storage

3. Login security mein izafi teh (layer) dalne wala tool kaun sa hai?
(a) Screensaver
(b) Two-Factor Authentication
(c) Wallpaper
(d) Search engine

4. Kaun sa cyber threat users ko dhoka de kar un se zaati maloomat leta hai?
(a) Phishing
(b) Antivirus
(c) Encryption
(d) Backup

5. Firewall ka maqsad kya hai?
(a) Files delete karna
(b) Nuqsan-deh network traffic rokna
(c) Games khelna
(d) Computer slow karna

6. Encryption kis liye use hoti hai?
(a) Data delete karne ke liye
(b) Data sab ke liye parhne ke qabil banane ke liye
(c) Data ko mehfooz shakal mein badalne ke liye
(d) Data khud ba khud upload karne ke liye

7. Online collaboration ke liye aam use hone wala platform kaun sa hai?
(a) Paint
(b) Google Workspace
(c) Notepad
(d) VLC Player

8. Digital etiquette ka matlab kya hai?
(a) Saari files azadi se share karna
(b) Online badtameez zaban use karna
(c) Mehfooz aur shaista online rawaiya
(d) Team members ko nazarandaz karna

9. E-waste ka matlab kya hai?
(a) Purane kapre
(b) Electronic kachra
(c) Kacha maal (raw materials)
(d) Khane ka kachra

10. User ki privacy bachane wala bain-ul-aqwami (international) qanoon kaun sa hai?
(a) HTML
(b) GDPR
(c) CPU
(d) LAN
Pehle khud jawab sochein, phir neeche table se milayein. Har sawal ka jawab us topic ke lesson mein samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.caption: Multiple choice ke jawab
rows: (c) Convert data into a secure form (topic 9.2)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (PDF 140, page 136) sawal 10 ke liye C deti hai, lekin option (c) CPU hai, jo hardware hai, qanoon nahi. Chapter ka text (topic 9.5) batata hai ke GDPR European Union ka qanoon hai jo zaati data ki hifazat karta hai, is liye sahi jawab (b) GDPR hai. Baqi nau jawab text se milte hain.

items: Data bachane mein mazboot passwords ka kya kirdar hai? (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)
Mashkook software download karna computer par kaise asar dal sakta hai? (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)
Software updates aur security patches (hifazati marammat) install karna kyun zaroori hai? (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)
Cyber threats ki aam qismein kaun si hain, jaise phishing ya ransomware? (Jawab: topic 9.2 ka lesson.)
Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) online security kaise behtar karti hai? (Jawab: topic 9.2 ka lesson.)
Online platforms par privacy aur security settings sambhalne ki zimmedari kis ki hai? (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)
Intellectual property kya hai, aur digital istemal mein is ka ehtram kyun karna chahiye? (Jawab: topic 9.5 ka lesson.)
E-waste mahol par kaise asar dalta hai, aur sustainable computing kya hai? (Jawab: topic 9.5 ka lesson.)
GDPR jaise bain-ul-aqwami data protection laws kahan lagu hote hain? (Jawab: topic 9.5 ka lesson.)
Entrepreneurship kya hai? (Jawab: topic 9.4 aur Summary ka lesson.)
Online safety ki ahmiyat samjhaiye aur bataiye ke mazboot passwords aur mehfooz browsing ki aadatein zaati data kaise bachati hain. (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)
Computer security barqarar rakhne mein software updates aur security patches ka kirdar bataiye, aur purane (outdated) software ke khatre samjhaiye. (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)

Bataiye ke online platforms par privacy aur security settings kaise sambhali ja sakti hain. Samjhaiye ke data protection ke liye privacy policies parhna kyun zaroori hai. (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)

Cyber threats ki mukhtalif qismein samjhaiye, jaise viruses, phishing, ransomware, spyware aur DDoS attacks. Bataiye ke yeh khatre afraad aur idaron dono par kaise asar dalte hain. (Jawab: topic 9.2 ka lesson.)

Security tools aur techniques, jaise Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), biometric verification, firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS) aur antivirus software, bayan kijiye. Samjhaiye ke har ek data bachane mein kaise madad karta hai. (Jawab: topic 9.2 ka lesson.)

Entrepreneurship ka concept samjhaiye aur bataiye ke digital technologies ne entrepreneurs ke liye naye mauqe kaise paida kiye hain. Digital entrepreneurship ki kam az kam teen misalein dijiye. (Jawab: topic 9.4 ka lesson.)

Computing ke qanooni pehlu samjhaiye: GDPR jaise bain-ul-aqwami frameworks aur Pakistan ke cybercrime laws aur data protection policies. Yeh qawaneen digital maloomat ko kaise bachate hain? (Jawab: topic 9.5 ka lesson.)

Computing ke mahol aur muashre par asraat bayan kijiye. Samjhaiye ke e-waste management aur sustainable computing mahol ka nuqsan kaise kam kar sakte hain, aur saqafati aur samaji tabdeeli mein technology ka kirdar bataiye. (Jawab: topic 9.5 ka lesson.)

blocks.prompt: Chapter 9 ki kitab ki answer key ka kaun sa jawab ghalat hai, aur sahi kya hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 10: key (c) deti hai jo CPU hai; sahi jawab (b) GDPR hai. Baqi nau jawab (B, C, B, A, B, C, B, C, B) matan se milte hain.
